Relaxing, novel experience on a classic, beautifully restored boat. Highly recommended.
Jan 2026 • Couples
A wonderful, large, classic boat (ship really considering it's size!). Anchored in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City with panoramic views of the city and the amazing light shows that utilise the cities buildings as screens. 

Service was excellent with very attentive friendly staff. My wife and I had summer rolls (spring rolls) followed by lamb cutlets and a serve of asparagus. This was savoured with room temperature red wine, a blessing! The first drop of red we've had that wasn't served at sub zero temperature (slight exaggeration!). 

Overall a memorable more upmarket experience, worth the the value.
Read more
Insider tip:
Just go! See How Chi Minh City from the harbour while enjoying delicious food.
